items.title: Lou Donaldson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I said, “You want some gigs? Can you play a blues?” He said, “Yeah.” So I took him on a couple of gigs.

ctx.x: I was about to ask you.

Yeah, I brought Horace. Horace was working...was practicing down at the studio where we used to go and train for boxing, Newman’s Studio down on ‘16th Street. I used to hear him playing piano. So one day I knocked on the door. I said, “Are you a piano player?” He said, “Yeah.” I said, “You want some gigs? Can you play a blues?” He said, “Yeah.” So I took him on a couple of gigs. He couldn’t play no blues. I said, “Man, you’re going to have to start playing blues.” Then I used to call him the “old Portuguese piano…
So you met him in New York.
